name: temporary-workspace-remote
summary: Typert Remote protocol for isolated temporary Session directories and one Client-only sidebar group.
rationale: Each creation keeps its own workspace-* child cwd. The Client groups those Sessions by the canonical configured parent without changing Host Workspace membership or Session headers.

transport.resultShape: RemoteResult<T> = { ok: true, value: T } | { ok: false, error: { code, message } }

capabilitySecurity.model: canonical group root plus opaque reservation id
capabilitySecurity.description: prepareGroup() exposes only the canonical configured parent used for Client classification. reserve() mints the only handle accepted by adopt(), retain(), and discard(); no cleanup method accepts a caller-supplied path.
capabilitySecurity.verifiedBy: settings-service.spec.ts verifies canonical group preparation; reservations.spec.ts verifies containment, opaque-id deletion, symlink resistance, and crash recovery.

prepareGroup.effect: Creates the configured parent when necessary and returns its fs.realpath canonical path for exact immediate-child matching in the Client.

reserve.effect: Creates a unique workspace-* child below the configured parent, writes a pending marker, and sweeps abandoned reservations first.

adopt.effect: Registers the reserved child as a transient Workspace, validates and attaches the created Session, and clears its pending marker.

retain.effect: Clears the pending marker without deleting the child when rollback cannot prove deletion is safe.

discard.effect: Removes an unadopted reservation. Idempotent: a retired or unknown id reports found: false.

describeSettings.effect: Returns the revision-fenced live parent-directory setting used by the Web settings card.

saveSettings.effect: Normalizes an absolute non-filesystem-root path, creates and permission-checks it, persists it through DSH Settings, and uses it for future reservations and group matching.

pickRoot.effect: Uses the Host-native directory picker when available. A null path is cancellation.

lifecycle.currentFlow: Every group plus action reserves a new child, creates a transient Host Workspace, calls sessions.create({ workspaceId }) for a guaranteed-fresh Session, adopts the reservation, and best-effort removes only the Workspace registration.
lifecycle.presentation: ui-workspace claims Sessions whose canonical cwd is one immediate workspace-* child of the current canonical root, suppresses matching transient Workspace rows, and renders one contributed fold.
lifecycle.durability: Adopted directories and Session logs are retained. Removing a transient Workspace registration deletes neither; immutable Session cwd is never rewritten.
lifecycle.crashWindow: A Host crash between reserve and adopt/retain/discard leaves a pending marker. A later sweep reclaims only markers older than reservationRetentionMs.

configuration.root: Configurable parent directory; defaults to $DSH_HOME/temporary-workspaces. The Settings namespace is temporary-workspace.
configuration.reservationRetentionMs: Grace before an unadopted reservation is treated as abandoned; defaults to 3600000 and has a 60000 floor.
